mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view
mission_dimensions.route_note: Symptomatic seizure suppression in a provoked-seizure assay; not WWOX-specific (wild type responds). Not deep recovery; WWOX function would remain lost. Track B: no allele-specific datum.
mission_dimensions.the_two_dimensions_are_independent: a card keeps both: a variant-independent lever can be a partial-benefit lever, and a lesion-specific one can aim at deep recovery

p4_card.identity: Lithium (the salt used in the mouse experiment: lithium chloride; the clinical compound class is lithium carbonate), used in the one WWOX experiment as a tool inhibitor of GSK3beta. Map records R-04 (repurposing) and N-02 (negative translation) describe the same candidate and are linked to this one card.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Symptomatic seizure suppression is the only endpoint ever tested in a WWOX system; it is non-specific (wild type responds equally). A WWOX-specific disease-modifying rationale is not supported by the primary data. Transfer to the reference genotype: not established.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: Already studied once (Cheng 2020, one laboratory, one experiment). Not new; the question is whether the result means what it was read as meaning.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: Map R-04 class DEPRIORITIZE; N-02 negative translation; CLAIM 016, CLAIM 035, PAPER 019, PAPER 056; known-roads reconnaissance of 2026-10-20.
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE; Track A (allele-blind); not deep recovery.
p4_card.expected_contribution: UNKNOWN beyond non-specific seizure suppression; direction on the Wnt axis possibly adverse (INFERENZA).
p4_card.mechanism: Target: GSK3beta (among many); claimed: inhibits a kinase de-repressed by WWOX loss; the de-repression is read from a single Ser9 phosphorylation blot; the attribution of the seizure effect to GSK3beta rests on lithium alone.

for: Lithium suppressed the provoked seizure score in the null genotype (Figure 7d, null panel).
against: SPECIFICITY FAILED: lithium suppressed the provoked seizure in all three genotypes, wild type included (Figure 7d; entries 0, 22).

The causal attribution to GSK3beta rests on lithium alone; the paper's own Discussion names lithium's other documented actions, including Wnt/beta-catenin-dependent effects (entry 3). Lithium acts on many targets besides GSK3beta.

The only cell-line source (Wang 2012, PMID 22193544) reports Ser9 phosphorylation unchanged during retinoic-acid differentiation of SH-SY5Y cells, while WWOX rose (entry 5): that is a WWOX-gain, differentiation context, not a WWOX-loss measurement, and must not be read as a knockdown result; the knockdown experiment of that paper measured Tau phosphorylation (entry 8), not Ser9.
Direction conflict (INFERENZA): beta-catenin stabilisation by lithium would push an axis that is already raised in WWOX-loss organoids (map record R-04, axis M5; card P4-D-02).
Different control groups and schedules for lithium and ethosuximide inside one figure (entries 27, 28): the two drugs are not compared on equal terms.
A clinical anticonvulsant effect would be symptomatic: CLAIM 031 states that seizure control does not buy development.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Engineered null mouse versus a missense or compound human context; a provoked-seizure score in preweaning pups versus a human epilepsy; one laboratory.

p4_card.pharmacology: Approved compound (class level, from map record R-04) with a narrow therapeutic index and monitoring needs; CNS exposure is not in doubt. Nothing here is a statement about exposure in WWOX-DEE.
p4_card.paediatrics_and_interactions: UNKNOWN. No paediatric suitability is presumed by this card, for the candidate or for any historical authorisation of it for another use.

scope_of_checks.support_and_replication: One laboratory, one experiment; no replication.
scope_of_checks.formal_checks: The lithium figure panels were read from the image; the 2026-10-21 R2 figure readings (entries 27, 28) carry a blind locator audit (SUPPORTED) and a recorded softening of wording; the null-only wording of the Results text against the three-panel figure is a recorded text-versus-panel finding.
scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: The direction-conflict statement on the Wnt axis and the amplifier-not-driver reading are INFERENZA and are owed a blind audit by another actor.

p4_card.next_measurement: A provoked-seizure arm with an explicit, tested null versus wild-type contrast and the interaction reported, or a different GSK3beta inhibitor under the same design; and a kinase-activity or substrate-phosphorylation readout in a Wwox-null system. Until then no genotype-specific claim is available.
p4_card.status_reason: The one experiment failed its specificity test and the Wnt-axis direction may be adverse.
p4_card.value_added: Keeps the lithium result as what it is (non-specific symptomatic suppression, specificity failed) so it is not read as a WWOX-specific signal, and names the contrast that would change that.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): seven separate queries returned no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.

not_known: Whether lithium does anything in a Wwox-deficient system that it does not do in a wild-type one (the one experiment that tested it answered no).
Whether lithium moves GSK3beta Ser9 phosphorylation or kinase activity in a Wwox-null brain: lithium's effect on the Ser9 readout was not measured in this system.

Whether GSK3beta abundance or Ser9 state tracks activity here: abundance and activity are dissociable in this very system (S9-independent inhibition), and no kinase-activity assay exists in a WWOX system.
Whether the null-genotype hypersusceptibility is a driver of the developmental phenotype or an amplifier on a malformed brain (entry 6).
Whether the wild-type response is floor-limited in a way that hides a genotype difference.
Any allele-specific datum (Q230P class or splice allele): none exists for lithium.
Net direction on the Wnt axis: lithium stabilises beta-catenin, and WWOX-loss organoids show nuclear beta-catenin already raised (card P4-D-02).

bridge_gaps_exposed: The bridge compares a null-genotype row against the null disease row (a sign comparison only); the wild-type and heterozygote rows differ in genotype and are therefore reported as not comparable. That non-comparability is the specificity failure, and no summary field expresses it: read the assertion notes.
The Ser9 disease row has no drug-side row: lithium's effect on Ser9 was not measured.

input.reading_guard: OPPOSES_DISEASE_CHANGE on DR-LI-001 is a sign comparison inside the null genotype on one provoked-seizure score. The same suppression is present in wild type and heterozygote (DR-LI-002, DR-LI-003), so it says nothing specific to WWOX loss, nothing about the Q230P class, and nothing about efficacy or safety in any person.
card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried, and none may be derived from this card.

directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED means no matched comparison exists, which is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
A genetic or tool-compound row is not a row for the named drug: the identity of what was given is written in each assertion.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED on every card: the bridge has no network and no pharmacological-label search was run. It is not NO_MATCH_FOUND.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears; concentrations and vector quantities of the sources are deliberately not reproduced.
Every adjacent source is labelled NOT WWOX EVIDENCE at class level.
input.no_new_reading: No paper was opened for this card. Every locator is an existing entry of the deep-dive manifests PMID32000863.json and PMID22193544.json; the figure statements are those entries' own.
